title: Preserve source revisions and result-level availability for temporal research
evidence_level: Code-confirmed temporal-provenance risk in the local working tree; no production-wide contamination rate measured
summary: Current extraction updates can attach newer paper contents to the earliest submission date. Introduce immutable source revisions and explicit result-availability semantics before using historical cutoffs, while retaining one scholarly work identity across versions.

evidence.detail: The collector derives date_submitted from the arXiv created date; this is a work/publication date, not proof that each extracted result appeared in that version.
The current paper upsert updates dates and materials_extracted together without a result-level source-revision availability contract.
_available_at falls back to the minimum paper availability/submission/publication date, potentially backdating results introduced later.

scope: Define work_first_public_at, source_version_public_at, result_available_at, captured_at, availability_basis and unknown/uncertain status; distinguish public knowledge time from local capture time.
Pin downloaded source versions where the provider supports this; store source revision identifiers, content hashes and locators rather than overwrite scientific provenance.
Backfill only verifiable version metadata. Retain unknown availability for legacy results whose first occurrence cannot be demonstrated.
Propagate availability through derived-result dependencies and expose the basis to dataset and retrieval consumers.
acceptance: A fixture with v1 before cutoff and v2 after cutoff, where v2 first adds Tc or a structure, excludes the new result and its derived features from the earlier knowledge snapshot.
The same result observed in multiple source versions resolves to one scientific identity with multiple occurrences, while all versions remain grouped under one work for splitting.
Unknown result availability never silently inherits the earliest work date; strict historical dataset requests exclude it with a machine-readable reason.
A captured source can be resolved to its exact version and content hash; ingesting a later revision does not mutate the earlier revision or locator.
A dry-run migration report lists changed, unverifiable and unchanged records without inventing dates; rerunning the metadata import is idempotent.
The temporal policy and its tests document that retrieval cutoffs do not establish the absence of LLM pretraining contamination.
out_of_scope: Full-corpus source redownload or production backfill without a separately reviewed rollout
Claiming historical model novelty when model-training cutoffs are unknown

title: Enforce claim/example integrity and quarantine contradictory negative labels
evidence_level: Code-confirmed local schema and mapper gaps; release-admission blockers, not a demonstrated production incident
summary: Close the explicit_ambient plus NULL CHECK loophole, bind each ML example to the material of its target claim, and prevent a positive Tc interval or lower bound from becoming an accepted non-transition label. Implement additive migrations and real disposable-database tests rather than SQL-string assertions alone.

evidence.detail: The v1 pressure CHECK uses pressure_gpa = 0 without explicitly requiring non-NULL for explicit_ambient.
Explicit result status wins, but the subsequent negative-result contradiction check covers only exact Tc, not interval/gt/ge claims.
MlExample claim_id and material_id are independently valid foreign keys, with no composite target identity guarantee.

scope: Add a forward migration that makes required pressure semantics fail closed under SQL NULL logic and validates existing rows before enabling the constraint.
Use a composite target-claim/material constraint or an equivalently enforced database invariant; do not permit approximate feature matching to redefine target identity.
Define a complete result-status/value-relation compatibility table for exact, interval, lt/le, gt/ge and unreported values.
Keep contradictory raw observations and review reasons, but prevent accepted negative labels until the contradiction is resolved against the source.
acceptance: In an explicitly disposable PostgreSQL instance, explicit_ambient plus NULL is rejected, explicit_ambient plus 0 is accepted, and not_reported plus NULL remains valid.
Direct SQL insertion/update of an example whose target claim belongs to another material fails, even if both individual identifiers exist.

Parameterized mapper and persistence tests cover negative status with exact/interval/gt/ge positive-transition claims; every contradiction is retained as pending/inconclusive or rejected from accepted negative data.

A valid explicitly reported non-transition with Tmin, method, pressure semantics and an appropriate upper-bound/unreported representation remains representable; a missing Tc alone never becomes a negative label.
Boundary tests reject NaN/Infinity and invalid value shapes through the database, not just the application validator.
The migration emits a preflight audit of incompatible legacy rows and does not repair them by filling pressure with 0 or discarding raw evidence; released historical migration files remain unchanged.
out_of_scope: Inferring negative experiments from absent Tc values or Discovery negative-control membership
Changing accepted historical scientific values without provenance-backed review
owner_role: Backend/data engineer with superconductivity domain reviewer

title: Implement a revision-aware, idempotent shadow research loader
evidence_level: Documented missing capability: an offline exporter/planner exists, but no approved end-to-end revision-aware database loader
summary: Turn reviewed offline plans into a controlled shadow-database import with stable source occurrences, interpretation revisions and snapshot memberships. Preserve legacy identities and raw records, and make dry-run accounting and idempotence prerequisites for any canary load.

evidence.detail: The existing planner writes deterministic files but explicitly performs no database writes.
The future loader must derive the authoritative source snapshot from the verified manifest, not trust source_snapshots.jsonl by itself.
The legacy material/source_record_hash uniqueness boundary is deliberately retained pending a stable occurrence and interpretation-revision loader.
snapshot_event_memberships provide a starting schema for repeat capture without duplicating scientific events.

scope: Specify stable work, source revision, source occurrence, result and interpretation-revision identities; keep repeated capture distinct from independent evidence.
Validate the source export, plan hashes, safe paths, row accounting and accepted work mappings before constructing authoritative source snapshot rows.
Implement dry-run and transactional shadow import, explicit pending review defaults, deterministic membership upserts and structured failure reports.
Replace legacy uniqueness only through a reviewed forward migration after compatibility tests; preserve existing claim IDs and legacy public read paths.
Document interruption/retry behavior, canary selection, post-load parity checks and rollback without deleting previously accepted scientific history.
acceptance: Two imports of the same reviewed bundle produce the same identities, counts and hashes, with no duplicate claims/events or memberships.

Capturing the same occurrence in another source snapshot adds the expected membership without counting it as a new independent result; a changed interpretation creates a new revision with a supersession link.
Dry-run accounts for every input occurrence as reused, inserted, revised, quarantined or failed and leaves all database tables unchanged.
Missing leaf files, tampered hashes, path traversal, unaccepted work links and incomplete accounting fail before publication; no partially loaded source snapshot becomes validated/frozen.
A forced interruption followed by retry either rolls back or resumes deterministically according to a documented transaction boundary, retaining the previous valid state.
Post-load parity independently compares identities, Tc/pressure semantics, source counts and retraction state; legacy records and existing API responses are unchanged by shadow loading.
No loaded legacy claim becomes accepted merely because parsing or import succeeded; promotion requires the configured scientific and licensing reviews.
out_of_scope: Automatically enabling research public endpoints
Production-wide backfill before a reviewed canary and parity report
Silently replacing the legacy material read model

title: Freeze complete research dependency closures with concurrency-safe DAG integrity
evidence_level: Explicitly documented pre-release gap; existing direct self-reference and relational checks are not a full immutable closure
summary: Provide one authoritative freeze operation that captures the complete dependencies of a research dataset, prevents concurrent cycles and mutations, and preserves immutable history when sources or interpretations are corrected. A populated manifest hash alone is not sufficient proof of a frozen research release.

evidence.detail: The implementation explicitly defers multi-hop/concurrent cycle checks and complete dependency-closure freezing.
The current evidence_self check blocks direct self-reference, not arbitrary multi-hop or concurrently introduced cycles.
A frozen dataset currently requires a manifest hash and timestamp, but this condition does not itself lock all referenced objects.

scope: Define the closure over targets, inputs, states, structures, run settings, artifacts, source and interpretation revisions, reviews, memberships and task/registry versions.
Implement an atomic freeze writer with a documented concurrency/locking strategy shared by all dependency writers.
Reject multi-hop cycles and prevent post-freeze changes or new edges from altering the frozen closure; verify referenced artifact hashes and availability.
Represent corrections, retractions and supersessions as new revisions plus an append-only post-release notice; preserve the original frozen contents for reproducibility.
acceptance: An offline verifier reconstructs the declared closure and hashes from the release bundle and rejects a missing dependency, mismatched revision or changed artifact byte stream.
Two simultaneous transactions attempting A derives_from B and B derives_from A cannot both commit; longer-cycle and direct-cycle adversarial cases are also rejected.
A freeze racing with a dependency insertion or result revision either includes a consistent complete version or rejects/retries; it never publishes a mixed closure.

Attempts to update/delete a frozen target, state, structure, run setting, evidence revision, review or membership cannot change the historical release; attempts to append a dependency to a frozen node are equally guarded.
A legitimate correction creates a new version and visible supersession/retraction notice without rewriting the old release hash; the corrected version can be independently frozen.
The same stable occurrence can belong to multiple source snapshots without duplication or loss of membership provenance in either frozen release.
Freeze retry is idempotent, failed verification never advances release status, and permission-bypass/direct SQL attempts are covered in a guarded disposable database.
out_of_scope: Treating hash integrity as scientific truth or publication authorization
Mutating old releases to make corrected results appear historically available
owner_role: Backend/database engineer with scientific data governance reviewer

title: Implement a limited scientific property importer with state, structure and run validation
evidence_level: Documented capability gap: a small backend registry exists, but the 126-field display dictionary is not an import or scientific validation contract
summary: Complete end-to-end ingestion for a deliberately limited core property set before expanding fields. Each value must remain bound to a validated state, structure, method/run, normalization and source, with unsupported or ambiguous data explicitly quarantined rather than coerced into comparable scalars.

evidence.detail: PROPERTY_UNITS currently registers eight scientific quantities and four RPS quantities, not all Discovery display fields.
Artifact existence, type and hash shape explicitly do not replace importer validation of coordinates, composition and scientific matching.
The 0045 schema is versioned and must not be mutated after release; registry expansion needs a forward-compatible version/migration.

scope: Version a small backend property registry with value kinds, canonical units, applicability and required scientific context; generate/read frontend definitions from the same contract where practical.
Implement strict import for available core properties and typed missingness. Keep Tc in material_claims and keep RPS in its inferred assessment pathway.
Require normalization and method context for DOS, energies/hull, EPC lambda/omega_log, phonons and stiffness; unsupported physical conventions remain unconverted with review reasons.
Parse coordinate-backed structures safely; record composition/occupancy, cell conventions, symmetry tolerance, artifact hash and state/run matching decisions.

Use three to five genuine, redistribution-permitted input/output packages spanning more than one context, plus separate negative fixtures for failures and invalid matches; record failures and costs as first-class outcomes.
acceptance: Each admitted value resolves to its original value/unit, normalized representation, result identity, state, source locator and method/run; unregistered keys or missing mandatory context are rejected or quarantined with explicit reasons.

Fixtures distinguish EPC lambda from penetration depth, K-valued omega_log from frequency, DOS per atom/formula unit/cell, and two-dimensional from three-dimensional stiffness; no unsupported conversion silently succeeds.
Energy/hull and phonon entries retain pressure/reference/approximation context, including harmonic versus anharmonic handling; incompatible protocols cannot be silently pooled as equivalent features.

A formula-only record or structure-description string cannot generate coordinate-derived features; mismatched composition, wrong artifact kind, malformed coordinates and invalid hashes fail importer validation.

Lambda and omega_log from different pressures or runs cannot be automatically combined; an explicitly reviewed approximate match has a policy/version, rationale and uncertainty rather than masquerading as an exact match.
The real-package canary can be imported and verified twice with identical results, includes a documented failed/inconclusive outcome, and reports unsupported fields without inflating completeness.
All newly exposed website-owned labels, units, errors and missingness explanations default to English; synthetic preview values are never accepted by the production importer.
out_of_scope: Requiring all 126 display fields on every material
Computing a unique real structure, band structure or Tc from formula alone
Launching bulk paid DFT/DFPT jobs or executing scripts embedded in imported artifacts
owner_role: Scientific software/data engineer with condensed-matter reviewer

title: Build task-specific ML datasets with split, temporal and dependency-leakage gates
evidence_level: Missing formal dataset-builder capability; existing tables and offline source export are not a validated training release
summary: Create a deterministic dataset builder whose task contract determines admissible labels, features, availability, grouping and evaluation. Prevent outcome-derived and cross-work/series leakage, and publish explicit exclusion and coverage artifacts instead of selecting the most complete aggregate columns.

evidence.detail: The documented rollout requires work/material/series/time leakage tests before ML snapshots are created.
ML examples store split and task metadata, but stored fields alone do not validate how assignments or preprocessing were produced.
ml_example_inputs can record input-event lineage and provides a starting point for dependency-aware feature admission.

scope: Define versioned task manifests: estimand/target, Tc criterion, measurement window, Observed/Computed policy, pressure/state range, feature budget, cutoff, censoring handling and excluded labels.
Build examples only from validated frozen inputs and the declared target revision; keep formula/condition and structure subsets explicit.

Validate work, source occurrence, sample/trajectory, parent series and configured structure-near-duplicate groups before assigning splits; distinguish interpolation, extrapolation and family holdout tasks.
Traverse feature dependencies for target leakage and temporal availability; enforce train-only fitting of preprocessing and learned retrieval/feature adapters.
Emit data/task cards, labels/features schemas, fixed split assignments, exclusion/coverage reports, dependency manifest and environment/configuration metadata.
acceptance: Rebuilding the same task from the same frozen input produces identical example identities, assignments and artifact hashes; no public offset API is used as the consistency boundary.
Adversarial examples with one work in arXiv/publisher versions, repeated citations, the same sample trajectory and declared near-duplicate groups cannot cross prohibited split boundaries.
Tc -> inferred lambda -> prediction of the same Tc and Tc-derived gap/coherence-length fixtures fail dependency admission, including multi-hop paths and renamed fields.

Post-cutoff results or dependencies and unknown availability under a strict historical policy are excluded with reason codes; the v1/v2 source-revision test remains effective through derived features.
Missing Tc and Discovery negative-control membership cannot create class negatives; censoring and incompatible Tc definitions follow the task contract and appear in coverage/exclusion summaries.
A test-only extreme value cannot alter training-fold imputation, scaling or feature-selection parameters; learned adapters are fit and versioned within the appropriate training fold.

The release includes independent work/state/trajectory counts, split balance, missingness, all exclusions and a machine-verifiable leakage report; an invalid task fails publication rather than emitting a warning-only training package.
out_of_scope: Universal all-family targets or random-split scores presented as new-material discovery evidence
RPS as a superconductivity ground-truth label
Deep-model training before the dataset contract is validated
owner_role: ML/data engineer with domain and benchmark reviewer

title: Restrict public research access to approved releases and enforce recursive export policies
evidence_level: Code-confirmed pre-publication authorization gap and unproven recursive export safety; no unauthorized disclosure demonstrated
summary: Do not equate ML_FOUNDATION_PUBLIC_ENABLED with approval to disclose every research snapshot. Enforce release-only anonymous access across lists and direct lookups, separate curator/reviewer/publisher authority, and validate exportable nested fields against source-specific access and licensing policies.

evidence.detail: Public-identity list routes accept include_unfrozen; a public feature flag is not a release-level approval decision.
The manifest detail route loads a snapshot by ID without a frozen/approved-release filter in this handler.
The exporter documents an exact top-level field contract, but materials.records remains a nested payload requiring its own field policy.
The license manifest is a useful declaration, but declarations alone do not prove nested payloads contain only export-permitted data.

scope: Add explicit reviewed/frozen/published release policy and role boundaries; preserve disabled-by-default behavior and separate internal source captures from public research releases.
Apply identical admission and field-level policies to collections, filters, counts, direct IDs, manifests and downloads; audit newly exposed claim/work endpoints as well.
Define recursive typed export schemas/allowlists and per-source/per-artifact access metadata; fail closed on unknown nested fields or unresolved export permissions.
Provide an approval audit trail and an export manifest describing included metadata/structured results, exclusions, licenses and permitted artifact access without redistributing restricted full text.
acceptance: Anonymous requests cannot retrieve building, pending, rejected or unpublished research data by list filter, include_unfrozen, direct ID, download URL or associated manifest; approved public releases remain accessible.
An authorization matrix verifies curator/reviewer/publisher/admin actions independently; changing a JSON status or self-declaring approved does not grant publication authority.

Canary restricted text embedded at multiple depths in records, metadata arrays and run/evidence payloads is rejected or excluded by the documented policy, even after the attacker recomputes checksums.
Unknown licensing/access status blocks the affected public export rather than being inferred from source name or code comments; the decision and omitted fields/artifacts are auditable.

A permitted metadata/structured-data bundle still verifies offline and resolves authorized sources without including licensed full text, secrets, private reviewer data or raw connection configuration.

Permission and visibility changes are tested through cached and uncached routes; withdrawn releases provide the defined notice/access behavior without silently rewriting immutable historical contents.
out_of_scope: A blanket legal determination that all APS/arXiv-derived records may be redistributed
Turning on public research routes as part of schema deployment
Changing public access to unrelated legacy endpoints without an explicit compatibility plan

title: Run a 60-event reviewed pilot and publish data quality, missingness and curation effort
evidence_level: Recommended bounded validation study; no completion, accuracy or sample-size sufficiency claimed
summary: Validate what can actually be recovered from SCLib sources before scaling extraction or ML. Review 60 candidate events using a predeclared selection plan, preserving failures and uncertain associations, and report the feasibility and human effort of each priority field rather than maximizing apparent completeness.

evidence.detail: The existing rollout requires human review of formula/work/mapper warnings and unexplained failures before loading.
Scientific coordinate validation and state matching remain importer/reviewer responsibilities rather than guarantees of the shadow schema.

scope: Preregister 60 candidate events, stratified by a small set of representative material families and evidence conditions, including theoretical/experimental, ambiguous pressure, censored/negative if available, multiple states and difficult source formats.

Capture source revision/locator, work/sample/state identity, Tc criterion/value, pressure semantics, raw evidence, method and review outcome using a versioned template; separate candidate events from their multiple atomic results.
Have a second reviewer independently assess a predeclared calibration subset and disputed cases, then retain arbitration and unresolved disagreement records.
Measure field-specific recoverability, extraction correctness, state-association errors, missingness reasons, source access restrictions and active human curation time.
Produce a reviewed canary bundle and an explicit go/narrow/stop recommendation for schema, importer and dataset work; permit a manual/offline pilot before the database loader is complete.
acceptance: The selection manifest identifies all 60 candidates and their selection strata before completion; inaccessible or irrecoverable events remain in the denominator and cannot be silently replaced to improve results.
Every accepted atomic result resolves to a permitted source locator and explicit sample/state/Tc-criterion interpretation; unresolved associations remain unknown/pending with reasons.
The pilot report distinguishes candidate events, atomic results, independent works, states and structures; repeated citations or dense pressure points are not counted as independent materials.
Field-by-field reports separate not reported, not accessible, not extracted, ambiguous, conflicted and not applicable; source and normalization errors are listed independently of coverage.

The preregistered second-review subset and disagreement log are completed with arbitration/remaining uncertainty recorded; no arbitrary accuracy threshold is used to conceal unresolved scientific cases.
Curation time and recovery yield are reported by field/source class, with privacy-safe logs and a concrete recommendation on which fields to keep, defer or narrow.

The deliverable explicitly states that 60 candidate events validate the workflow, not statistical sufficiency for cross-family ML or a deep model; no missing negative examples or structures are manufactured to meet quotas.
out_of_scope: Full-database re-extraction or completion of all 126 display fields
Training an ML model on pilot size alone
Inventing unavailable source permissions, negative labels or state matches
owner_role: Condensed-matter reviewer with data-curation engineer and independent reviewer

title: Publish reproducible ML baseline evaluations against audited dataset releases
evidence_level: Recommended research capability; predictive gains and sufficient independent data are not yet established
summary: Evaluate simple baselines against a fixed audited dataset release and publish reproducible predictions, grouped errors, coverage and limitations. This independently closeable milestone establishes the evidence needed to decide whether more complex models or a separately scoped active-learning experiment are justified; improvement is not assumed.

evidence.detail: Stored work/material/series/duplicate grouping keys can support independent-sample reporting, but do not themselves establish an evaluated model.
The current implementation is an initial database/scoring/interface skeleton, explicitly not final research-platform acceptance or completed scientific data migration.

scope: Implement train-only family/statistical, composition, composition-plus-condition and available-structure-subset baselines with fixed splits and reproducible environments.
Publish per-example predictions and grouped evaluation artifacts, including independent work/trajectory counts, family/pressure strata, missingness and failed prediction coverage.
Separate observed and computed targets, document censoring and zero/negative handling, and evaluate uncertainty only where the task and sample size support it.
Define selection, tuning and failure-handling rules before inspecting held-out results; retain failed configurations and avoid post hoc test-set model selection.

Publish a data/model card and a continue/narrow/stop recommendation. Record insufficient independent data as a limitation and prioritize a data/case-study deliverable over unsupported significance claims.
acceptance: A clean environment can rebuild the baseline outputs from the pinned public/authorized dataset, split/configuration, code and dependency versions with documented deterministic tolerance.
Comparisons use identical test cases or explicitly labeled nested subsets; a better result on the easier structure subset is not presented as the causal value of structure features.

The evaluation reports MAE/median absolute error, appropriate stratified and grouped uncertainty summaries, censoring/negative-label handling and prediction coverage without claiming significance from insufficient independent groups.
There is no predefined requirement to improve accuracy; negative findings, weak baselines and insufficient sample size remain publishable and determine a documented continue/narrow/stop decision.
Observed and computed targets are evaluated separately unless an explicit task observation model justifies combination; log-scale metrics never silently transform negative, zero or censored outcomes.
Model selection uses training/validation information only; a held-out target perturbation cannot alter preprocessing or chosen hyperparameters, and failed configurations remain in the run ledger.

The final evaluation release pins all data and run manifests, includes a model/data card with applicability and failure modes, and is independently verifiable without conducting active learning or live calculations.
out_of_scope: Multi-fidelity or active-learning replay, which belongs to a separate issue
Automatic live experiments or paid computation without separate execution authorization
Cross-family foundation-model training as a required milestone
Declaring RPS, physical constraints or additional fields successful before measured comparisons
owner_role: ML researcher with scientific reviewer and research-budget owner
